import sys

sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
p = 1000000007

def fpm(a, b):
    return pow(a, b, p)

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    a = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    i100 = pow(100, p-2, p)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            a[i][j] = next(it) * i100 % p

    m = 1 << n
    # is array is not used, skip it
    # compute f[x][mask]
    f = [[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for mask in range(m):
            prod = 1
            for k in range(n):
                if (mask >> k) & 1:
                    prod = prod * a[k][i] % p
                else:
                    prod = prod * (p + 1 - a[k][i]) % p
            f[i][mask] = prod

    mx = (1 << m) - 1
    stt = 1 << 0  # only bit 0 set

    st = [dict() for _ in range(n+1)]

    def dfs(x, w):
        if x == n:
            return 1 if w == mx else 0
        if w in st[x]:
            return st[x][w]
        # compute s[j] for j=0..n-1
        s = [0]*n
        for i in range(m):
            if (w >> i) & 1:
                for j in range(n):
                    if not ((i >> j) & 1):  # j not in subset i
                        s[j] |= (1 << (i | (1<<j)))
        ans = 0
        for i in range(m):
            ng = w
            for j in range(n):
                if (i >> j) & 1:
                    ng |= s[j]
            ans = (ans + f[x][i] * dfs(x+1, ng)) % p
        st[x][w] = ans
        return ans

    result = dfs(0, stt)
    sys.stdout.write(str(result) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
